name: featureMembership
xml:
<ownedAttribute xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-featureMembership" ns0:type="uml:Property" isDerived="true" isOrdered="true" name="featureMembership">
            <association ns0:idref="Core-Types-A_featureMembership_type" />
            <lowerValue ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-featureMembership-lowerValue" ns0:type="uml:LiteralInteger" name="" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-featureMembership-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>The <code>FeatureMemberships</code> for <code>features</code> of this <code>Type</code>, which include all <code>ownedFeatureMemberships</code> and those <code>inheritedMemberships</code> that are <code>FeatureMemberships</code> (but does <em>not</em> include any <code>importedMemberships</code>).</p> ">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Types-Type-featureMembership" />
</ownedComment>
            <type ns0:idref="Core-Types-FeatureMembership" />
            <upperValue ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-featureMembership-upperValue" ns0:type="uml:LiteralUnlimitedNatural" name="" value="-1" />
          </ownedAttribute>

name: inheritableMemberships
xml:
<ownedOperation xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-inheritableMemberships_Namespace_Type_Boolean" ns0:type="uml:Operation" name="inheritableMemberships">
            <bodyCondition ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-inheritableMemberships_Namespace_Type_Boolean-unnamed1" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="unnamed1">
              <specification ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-inheritableMemberships_Namespace_Type_Boolean-unnamed1-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="let excludingSelf : Set(Type) = excludedType->including(self) in supertypes(excludeImplied)->reject(t | excludingSelf->includes(t)).     nonPrivateMemberships(excludedNamespaces, excludingSelf, excludeImplied) " language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
            </bodyCondition>
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-inheritableMemberships_Namespace_Type_Boolean-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>Return all the non-<code>private</code> <code>Memberships</code> of all the supertypes of this <code>Type</code>, excluding any supertypes that are this <code>Type</code> or are in the given set of <code>excludedTypes</code>. If <code>excludeImplied = true</code>, then also transitively exclude any supertypes from implied <code>Specializations</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Types-Type-inheritableMemberships_Namespace_Type_Boolean" />
</ownedComment>
            <ownedParameter ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-inheritableMemberships_Namespace_Type_Boolean-excludedNamespaces" ns0:type="uml:Parameter" name="excludedNamespaces">
              <lowerValue ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-inheritableMemberships_Namespace_Type_Boolean-excludedNamespaces-lowerValue" ns0:type="uml:LiteralInteger" name="" />
              <type ns0:idref="Root-Namespaces-Namespace" />
              <upperValue ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-inheritableMemberships_Namespace_Type_Boolean-excludedNamespaces-upperValue" ns0:type="uml:LiteralUnlimitedNatural" name="" value="-1" />
            </ownedParameter>
            <ownedParameter ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-inheritableMemberships_Namespace_Type_Boolean-excludedTypes" ns0:type="uml:Parameter" name="excludedTypes">
              <lowerValue ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-inheritableMemberships_Namespace_Type_Boolean-excludedTypes-lowerValue" ns0:type="uml:LiteralInteger" name="" />
              <type ns0:idref="Core-Types-Type" />
              <upperValue ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-inheritableMemberships_Namespace_Type_Boolean-excludedTypes-upperValue" ns0:type="uml:LiteralUnlimitedNatural" name="" value="-1" />
            </ownedParameter>
            <ownedParameter ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-inheritableMemberships_Namespace_Type_Boolean-excludeImplied" ns0:type="uml:Parameter" name="excludeImplied">
              <type href="https://www.omg.org/spec/UML/20161101/PrimitiveTypes.xmi#Boolean" />
            </ownedParameter>
            <ownedParameter ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-inheritableMemberships_Namespace_Type_Boolean-" ns0:type="uml:Parameter" isOrdered="true" name="">
              <lowerValue ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-inheritableMemberships_Namespace_Type_Boolean--lowerValue" ns0:type="uml:LiteralInteger" name="" />
              <type ns0:idref="Root-Namespaces-Membership" />
              <upperValue ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-inheritableMemberships_Namespace_Type_Boolean--upperValue" ns0:type="uml:LiteralUnlimitedNatural" name="" value="-1" />
            </ownedParameter>
            <ownedRule ns0:idref="Core-Types-Type-inheritableMemberships_Namespace_Type_Boolean-unnamed1" />
          </ownedOperation>

name: removeRedefinedFeatures
xml:
<ownedOperation xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-removeRedefinedFeatures_Membership" ns0:type="uml:Operation" name="removeRedefinedFeatures">
            <bodyCondition ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-removeRedefinedFeatures_Membership-unnamed1" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="unnamed1">
              <specification ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-removeRedefinedFeatures_Membership-unnamed1-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="let reducedMemberships : Sequence(Membership) =     memberships->reject(mem1 |         memberships->excluding(mem1)->             exists(mem2 | allRedefinedFeaturesOf(mem2)->                 includes(mem1.memberElement))) in let redefinedFeatures : Set(Feature) =      ownedFeature.redefinition.redefinedFeature->asSet() in reducedMemberships->reject(mem | allRedefinedFeaturesOf(mem)->     exists(feature | redefinedFeatures->includes(feature)))" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
            </bodyCondition>
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-removeRedefinedFeatures_Membership-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>Return a subset of <code>memberships</code>, removing those <code>Memberships</code> whose <code>memberElements</code> are <code>Features</code> and for which either of the following two conditions holds:</p>  <ol>  <li>The <code>memberElement</code> of the <code>Membership</code> is included in redefined <code>Features</code> of another <code>Membership</code> in <code>memberships</code>.</li>  <li>One of the redefined <code>Features</code> of the <code>Membership</code> is a directly <code>redefinedFeature</code> of an <code>ownedFeature</code> of this <code>Type</code>.</li> </ol>  <p>For this purpose, the redefined <code>Features</code> of a <code>Membership</code> whose <code>memberElement</code> is a <code>Feature</code> includes the <code>memberElement</code> and all <code>Features</code> directly or indirectly redefined by the <code>memberElement</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Types-Type-removeRedefinedFeatures_Membership" />
</ownedComment>
            <ownedParameter ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-removeRedefinedFeatures_Membership-memberships" ns0:type="uml:Parameter" isOrdered="true" name="memberships">
              <lowerValue ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-removeRedefinedFeatures_Membership-memberships-lowerValue" ns0:type="uml:LiteralInteger" name="" />
              <type ns0:idref="Root-Namespaces-Membership" />
              <upperValue ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-removeRedefinedFeatures_Membership-memberships-upperValue" ns0:type="uml:LiteralUnlimitedNatural" name="" value="-1" />
            </ownedParameter>
            <ownedParameter ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-removeRedefinedFeatures_Membership-" ns0:type="uml:Parameter" isOrdered="true" name="">
              <lowerValue ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-removeRedefinedFeatures_Membership--lowerValue" ns0:type="uml:LiteralInteger" name="" />
              <type ns0:idref="Root-Namespaces-Membership" />
              <upperValue ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-removeRedefinedFeatures_Membership--upperValue" ns0:type="uml:LiteralUnlimitedNatural" name="" value="-1" />
            </ownedParameter>
            <ownedRule ns0:idref="Core-Types-Type-removeRedefinedFeatures_Membership-unnamed1" />
          </ownedOperation>

name: deriveTypeFeatureMembership
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-deriveTypeFeatureMembership" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="deriveTypeFeatureMembership">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Types-Type" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-deriveTypeFeatureMembership-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>The <code>featureMemberships</code> of a <code>Type</code> is the union of the <code>ownedFeatureMemberships</code> and those <code>inheritedMemberships</code> that are <code>FeatureMemberships</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Types-Type-deriveTypeFeatureMembership" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Types-Type-deriveTypeFeatureMembership-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="featureMembership = ownedFeatureMembership->union( inheritedMembership->selectByKind(FeatureMembership))" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: namingFeature
xml:
<ownedOperation xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-namingFeature_" ns0:type="uml:Operation" name="namingFeature">
            <bodyCondition ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-namingFeature_-unnamed1" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="unnamed1">
              <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-namingFeature_-unnamed1-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="if ownedRedefinition->isEmpty() then null else ownedRedefinition->at(1).redefinedFeature endif" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
            </bodyCondition>
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-namingFeature_-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>By default, the naming <code>Feature</code> of a <code>Feature</code> is given by its first <code>redefinedFeature</code> of its first <code>ownedRedefinition</code>, if any.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-namingFeature_" />
</ownedComment>
            <ownedParameter ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-namingFeature_-" ns0:type="uml:Parameter" name="">
              <lowerValue ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-namingFeature_--lowerValue" ns0:type="uml:LiteralInteger" name="" />
              <type ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
              <upperValue ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-namingFeature_--upperValue" ns0:type="uml:LiteralUnlimitedNatural" name="" value="1" />
            </ownedParameter>
            <ownedRule ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-namingFeature_-unnamed1" />
          </ownedOperation>

name: checkFeatureParameterRedefinition
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureParameterRedefinition" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="checkFeatureParameterRedefinition">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureParameterRedefinition-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If a <code>Feature</code> is a <code>parameter</code> of an <code>owningType</code> that is a <code>Behavior</code> or <code>Step</code>, but <em>not</em> </p> <ul>     <li>A <code>result</code> <code>parameter</code></li>     <li>A <code>parameter</code> of an <code>InvocationExpression</code>, with at least one non-implied <code>ownedRedefinition</code></li> </ul> <p>then, for each direct supertype of its <code>owningType</code> that is also a <code>Behavior</code> or <code>Step</code>, it must redefine the <code>parameter</code> at the same position, if any.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureParameterRedefinition" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureParameterRedefinition-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="owningType <> null and not owningFeatureMembership.     oclIsKindOf(ReturnParameterMembership) and (owningType.oclIsKindOf(Behavior) or  owningType.oclIsKindOf(Step) and     (owningType.oclIsKindOf(InvocationExpression) implies       not ownedRedefinition->exists(not isImplied))  implies     let i : Integer =         owningType.ownedFeature->select(direction <> null)->             reject(owningFeatureMembership.                 oclIsKindOf(ReturnParameterMembership))->             indexOf(self) in     owningType.ownedSpecialization.general->         forAll(supertype |             let ownedParameters : Sequence(Feature) =                 supertype.ownedFeature->select(direction <> null)->                      reject(owningFeatureMembership.                          oclIsKindOf(ReturnParameterMembership)) in             ownedParameters->size() >= i implies                 redefines(ownedParameters->at(i))" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: checkFeatureEndRedefinition
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureEndRedefinition" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="checkFeatureEndRedefinition">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureEndRedefinition-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If a <code>Feature</code> has <code>isEnd = true</code> and an <code>owningType</code> that is not empty, then, for each direct supertype of its <code>owningType</code>, it must redefine the <code>endFeature</code> at the same position, if any.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureEndRedefinition" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureEndRedefinition-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="isEnd and owningType <> null implies     let i : Integer =          owningType.ownedEndFeature->indexOf(self) in     owningType.ownedSpecialization.general->         forAll(supertype |              supertype.endFeature->size() >= i implies                 redefines(supertype.endFeature->at(i))" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: checkFeatureResultRedefinition
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureResultRedefinition" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="checkFeatureResultRedefinition">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureResultRedefinition-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If a <code>Feature</code> is a <code>result</code> <code>parameter</code> of an <code>owningType</code> that is a <code>Function</code> or <code>Expression</code>, then, for each direct supertype of its <code>owningType</code> that is also a <code>Function</code> or <code>Expression</code>, it must redefine the <code>result</code> <code>parameter</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureResultRedefinition" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Core-Features-Feature-checkFeatureResultRedefinition-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="owningType <> null and (owningType.oclIsKindOf(Function) and     self = owningType.oclAsType(Function).result or  owningType.oclIsKindOf(Expression) and     self = owningType.oclAsType(Expression).result) implies     owningType.ownedSpecialization.general->         select(oclIsKindOf(Function) or oclIsKindOf(Expression))->         forAll(supertype |             redefines(                 if superType.oclIsKindOf(Function) then                     superType.oclAsType(Function).result                 else                     superType.oclAsType(Expression).result                 endif)" language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
          </ownedRule>

name: validateNamespaceDistinguishibility
xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Root-Namespaces-Namespace-validateNamespaceDistinguishibility" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="validateNamespaceDistinguishibility">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Root-Namespaces-Namespace" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Root-Namespaces-Namespace-validateNamespaceDistinguishibility-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>All <code>memberships</code> of a <code>Namespace</code> must be distinguishable from each other.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Root-Namespaces-Namespace-validateNamespaceDistinguishibility" />
            </ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Root-Namespaces-Namespace-validateNamespaceDistinguishibility-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="membership->forAll(m1 | membership->forAll(m2 | m1 <> m2 implies m1.isDistinguishableFrom(m2)))" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>

name: isDistinguishableFrom
xml:
<ownedOperation xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Root-Namespaces-Membership-isDistinguishableFrom_Membership" ns0:type="uml:Operation" name="isDistinguishableFrom">
            <bodyCondition ns0:id="Root-Namespaces-Membership-isDistinguishableFrom_Membership-unnamed1" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="unnamed1">
              <specification ns0:id="Root-Namespaces-Membership-isDistinguishableFrom_Membership-unnamed1-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="not (memberElement.oclKindOf(other.memberElement.oclType()) or      other.memberElement.oclKindOf(memberElement.oclType())) or (shortMemberName = null or     (shortMemberName <> other.shortMemberName and      shortMemberName <> other.memberName)) and (memberName = null or     (memberName <> other.shortMemberName and      memberName <> other.memberName))) " language="OCL2.0" name="">
</specification>
            </bodyCondition>
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Root-Namespaces-Membership-isDistinguishableFrom_Membership-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>Whether this <code>Membership</code> is distinguishable from a given <code>other</code> <code>Membership</code>. By default, this is true if this <code>Membership</code> has no <code>memberShortName</code> or <code>memberName</code>; or each of the <code>memberShortName</code> and <code>memberName</code> are different than both of those of the <code>other</code> <code>Membership</code>; or neither of the metaclasses of the <code>memberElement</code> of this <code>Membership</code> and the <code>memberElement</code> of the <code>other</code> <code>Membership</code> conform to the other. But this may be overridden in specializations of <code>Membership</code>.</p> ">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Root-Namespaces-Membership-isDistinguishableFrom_Membership" />
</ownedComment>
            <ownedParameter ns0:id="Root-Namespaces-Membership-isDistinguishableFrom_Membership-other" ns0:type="uml:Parameter" name="other">
              <type ns0:idref="Root-Namespaces-Membership" />
            </ownedParameter>
            <ownedParameter ns0:id="Root-Namespaces-Membership-isDistinguishableFrom_Membership-" ns0:type="uml:Parameter" name="">
              <type href="https://www.omg.org/spec/UML/20161101/PrimitiveTypes.xmi#Boolean" />
            </ownedParameter>
            <ownedRule ns0:idref="Root-Namespaces-Membership-isDistinguishableFrom_Membership-unnamed1" />
          </ownedOperation>
